acceptance: Assembler produces wheel and self-contained sdist with static matching versions and benchbox_provenance.json containing upstream/fork SHAs and manifest; no upstream console scripts, sqlglotc or rs extras leak.
Tests prove unchanged SQL literals, fail-closed residual module-reference checks, dynamic import and plugin isolation, all built-in dialect loading, pickle/spawn and separate AST identities.

Fresh environments install wheel and offline sdist-built wheel outside checkout, including a fixture transitive dependency on upstream SQLGlot, both import orders and uninstall directions. Runtime payloads and reproducible wheel outputs match; py.typed and license are included.
Relocated upstream unit suite runs against the installed artifact; Python3.11–3.14 smoke checks and native source/compiled checks pass with a bounded matrix.

Source-preserving refresh procedure is exercised in a local Git fixture across two refreshes including one upstreamed/retired patch; final source tree equals the verified rebased candidate with no retired patch resurrection.

Fork release workflow accepts only explicit downstream tag/version and owner publishing configuration, retains candidate artifacts+SHA256SUMS for30days, and cannot publish upstream names. Monthly check is read-only; refresh/rollback/exit rules are documented.

Prospective consumer wrapper, SQLite and BigQuery tests pass against the built artifact using only the planned import changes in an isolated merged-base copy; a real new semantic regression blocks publication for an owner decision.
Reviewed packaging/CI PR is merged; exact candidate artifact hashes, tests and source head are recorded. No publication or settings changes without owner authorization.

description: Implement downstream release assembly, artifact/installed-suite tests, CI and refresh operations in joeharris76/sqlglot using downstream/ to preserve upstream source layout. Distribution benchbox-sqlglot, namespace benchbox_sqlglot, initial version30.23.0.1. Use static metadata and provenance, pure Python, preserved py.typed/license, syntax-aware relocation and isolated plugin group. Enforce self-contained sdist and reproducible builds. Keep publication explicit and owner-controlled. Run prospective BenchBox consumer tests against the built artifact from a disposable copy of the merged BigQuery prerequisite.
